title: Long BTC — Risk-On Confirmation + AI Capex Correlation
entry: Scale in: 40% at $76-$78K (current zone); 30% on confirmed Wednesday close above $80K; 30% on breakout above $82K with volume. Avoid chasing >$84K without consolidation.
stop_loss: $72K daily close — breaks the May 19 swing low; correlation hedge to NDX fails
catalyst: BTC closed Wednesday at ~$78,500 (+1.7%) — same daily move as NDX (+1.5%) and ETH (+1.7%). Risk-on correlation is intact and AI capex confirmation is bullish for digital risk assets. SpaceX $75B IPO at $1.75T valuation (June 12) is a 'risk-asset-friendly' liquidity signal — institutions selling existing positions to fund new growth allocations spreads bid to BTC.
thesis: Bitcoin is trading as a high-beta NDX proxy — the daily correlation has been 0.65-0.78 over the last 30 days. The AI capex narrative that's pulling NVDA and semis higher is the same narrative supporting BTC: it's a 'long innovation, long digital-economy' regime. The catalysts for continued BTC strength: (1) NVDA's confirmation of secular AI demand keeps the risk-on framework intact through summer; (2) SpaceX IPO sucks $75B into growth-asset bid, signaling institutional appetite for non-traditional risk; (3) Fed hawkishness is paradoxically supportive longer-term — if the Fed loses credibility on inflation control, the BTC-as-hedge narrative re-emerges; (4) US election year typically brings policy stimulus and weakening dollar tail risk. The cleanest expression is spot BTC or IBIT (BlackRock spot ETF). Don't size aggressively because correlation breaks at extremes — if NDX falls hard, BTC will fall harder. But within a constructive AI capex regime, BTC is the highest-beta way to participate.
bull_case: NDX breaks above 27,000 within 2 weeks on NVDA continuation; BTC follows to $88-92K. SpaceX trading debut June 12 is a successful event; risk-on momentum extends. Spot Ethereum staking ETF approved Q2 (already in motion); brings crypto-curious institutional capital. Tail: a single nation-state announces BTC reserve buying (Argentina, El Salvador expansion) — BTC to $110-120K.
bear_case: 30Y spikes above 5.20% post-PCE May 27; risk-off across growth assets; BTC sells off harder than NDX (typical correlation in stress). $72K stop triggered, possibly extending to $65K on continued momentum. Tail: a major exchange or stablecoin issuer experiences a credit event; BTC drops to $60K-$65K rapidly.
invalidation: Daily close below $72K, OR NDX below 25,500 with VIX above 20

outcome.outcome_label: Stop triggered — BTC closed below $72K threshold at $69,503
outcome.note: Bitcoin fell to the $69,350–$69,666 range on June 2, 2026 (CoinGecko: $69,503; CoinDesk: $69,351; Coinbase: $69,666), decisively breaking the $72K daily-close stop. The risk-on liquidity thesis required a macro backdrop — 30Y below 5.00% AND Iran de-escalation — that has not materialized. Three consecutive sessions of 30Y near or above 5.01%, combined with Iran talks explicitly suspended per the June 2 Tasnim agency report, represent the dual-headwind invalidation scenario. BTC slipped below its 20, 50, and 100-day EMAs near $76,400–$76,700, confirming the technical support failure. Return from reference price $76,643 to close $69,503 = -9.3%.
